title: Determination
description: An Authority's ruling about Allegations and/or Obligations. Bound to gist:Determination. A single Proceeding may accumulate multiple Determinations (trial → appeal → reversal); each Determination is a separate authoritative ruling.

issuedBy.description: IRI of the of:Authority that issued the ruling.

decides.description: IRIs of of:Allegation records this Determination resolves. Multi-valued: one ruling can decide multiple Allegations. Adjudicative Determinations (every disposition except 'issued') MUST have at least one entry — enforced by the if/then constraint below. Administrative Determinations (disposition='issued', for promulgating an Instrument or recording a posture statement) MAY leave this empty.

disposition.description: Closed vocabulary. 'issued' is used when a Determination promulgates an Instrument (e.g., issuance of a JIA) rather than ruling on an Allegation. Every other (adjudicative) disposition requires a non-empty 'decides'.

anchors.description: IRIs of of:Obligation records this Determination interprets or applies.

remedy.description: Unstructured remedy object in v0.1. Typed of:Remedy entity deferred to v0.2.

target_instrument.description: When disposition='issued', the of:Instrument being promulgated.

notes.description: Free-text editorial or provenance notes about this record.

ecli_uri.description: ECLI URI for a citable court decision (crosswalk matrix in PROTOCOL.md).

neutral_citation.description: Neutral citation (e.g. '2024 BCCRT 149'). Crosswalk for citable decisions in common-law neutral-citation jurisdictions (crosswalk matrix in PROTOCOL.md).

urn_lex.description: urn:lex identifier. Crosswalk for administrative determinations without an ECLI (crosswalk matrix in PROTOCOL.md).

ref.description: Jurisdiction code: lowercase form of an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country/supranational code or an ISO 3166-2 subdivision code.

sameAs.description: owl:sameAs crosswalk IRIs: external records identical to this one (e.g. a live adopter export, a Wikidata entity).

exactMatch.description: skos:exactMatch crosswalk IRIs: external concepts interchangeably usable with this record. Weaker than owl:sameAs; preferred for cross-scheme concept joins.
